text:
mira: ACME asked for parity with CompetitorX: per-route spend caps + tenant model pinning + tiered latency SLAs. they want a pilot in ~6 weeks. can we scope an MVP?

alex: summary: policy surface + gateway enforcement + telemetry/audit + UI for sales/ops. key constraint: avoid large billing backend changes for MVP.

sam: gateway enforcement plan: estimate tokens from input length -> multiply by model rate -> compare to profile cap. if over -> try fallback list -> if none, return 402-like error.

joan: propose lightweight "Routing Profile" schema (one-liner): name, preferred_model, cost_cap_monthly_cents, p95_latency_ms, fallback_sequence, pin_model_version. e.g.:
```json
{"name":"gold","preferred_model":"rw-large-v2","cost_cap_monthly_cents":150000,"p95_latency_ms":300,"fallback":["rw-medium-v2","rw-small-quant"],"pin_model_version":true}
```

alex: MVP scope: API/Console CRUD for profiles, gateway hook for estimate+fallback, per-profile telemetry, pilot limits (3 profiles/tenant), sales simulator (simple). no billing hard-blocks in MVP (soft-blocks via gateway).

ben: risks: cardinality explosion for metrics (tenant x route x profile). mitigate by sampling low-tier traffic and capping profiles in pilot. also cost estimation is heuristic. we need clear docs for estimator accuracy and dispute audit logs.

tess: sales note: ACME wants demoable behavior. model pinning is important for them because they saw silent upgrades elsewhere. they prefer a visible "pin" switch in UI.

alex: SDK sample we'll include in docs:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/routing-profiles \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -d '{"name":"gold","preferred_model":"rw-large-v2","cost_cap_monthly_cents":150000}'
```

joan: launch criteria (pilot): pilot region at target load, p95 for gold under 350ms, per-profile cost dashboard and alerts, per-invocation audit events retained 90d, global feature toggle for emergency rollback, legal-approved pilot wording.

sam: rough schedule: 1wk design/spike, 2wks infra + estimator, 1wk console, 1wk QA/canary -> ~5wks + 1wk buffer for legal/sales.

legal-bot: NOTE: "Pilot SLAs are non-contractual." Legal must review external materials before demo.

ben: ops controls: limit 3 profiles/tenant, sample telemetry for low tiers, provide ops override in Console to unpin/disable profiles. also provide a lightweight simulator so sales can show expected savings.

mira: action items: @sam spike + branch, @joan draft schema + UI mock, @ben cardinality estimate, @tess prepare sales demo inputs, @mira coordinate legal & pilot SOW. meeting Fri 10am to finalize.

deploy-bot: branch created: feature/tenant-routing-profiles (by sam). PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/4402

sam: ack  will post spike notes by EOD tomorrow. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
